//: The payments exceptions desk. A release is the one irreversible step, so it is the one the graph is asked about.

The sanctions list in the seed is synthetic. A beneficiary three ownership or control hops from a listed entity matches no name on the list; the graph still sees it. A hold here is a risk-based review, stricter than the OFAC 50 Percent Rule on purpose.
Structuring counts what the beneficiary has already received, which only the transfer graph knows: no single payment in the pattern looks wrong.

rules.description: Only payments operations sees the tools that release or hold a payment.
rules.reason: Releasing and holding payments is for payments operations.

rules.description: A release is held when the beneficiary is within three ownership or control hops of an entity on the sanctions list, and goes to a sanctions officer.
rules.reason: HELD: the beneficiary of {{payment_id}} is {{hops}} hops from {{listed}} ({{entry}}) on the sanctions list: {{chain}}. A name screen does not show this; the ownership graph does. Do not release or re-route it. Call Bank_RequestApproval with action=release_payment, resource_id={{payment_id}} and justification=<what you know about the beneficiary>, then stop: a sanctions officer decides. If they approve, retry Bank_ReleasePayment with payment_id={{payment_id}} once.

rules.description: A release is held when it would be the fourth or later payment just under $10,000 into the same beneficiary within fourteen days.
rules.reason: HELD: {{payment_id}} would be payment number {{count}} between {{floor}} and {{threshold}} dollars into {{beneficiary}} within {{window_days}} days; the earlier ones came from {{senders}} different senders. That is a structuring pattern. Do not release, split or re-route it. Call Bank_RequestApproval with action=release_payment, resource_id={{payment_id}} and justification=<what you know about the payment>, then stop: a sanctions officer decides. If they approve, retry Bank_ReleasePayment with payment_id={{payment_id}} once.

rules.description: Only a sanctions officer decides a held release.
rules.reason: DENIED: {{request_id}} is a held payment release, which only a sanctions officer decides.
